purpose: Controlled test conditions. None describes an observed live provider outage.
scope_note: Examples to adapt. Assignment.pdf sets the required coverage for this track; not every listed scenario is mandatory in every track.

scenarios.all_attempts: TIMEOUT, retryable true; your workflow must impose its own retry bound

scenarios.setup: Submit the same request ID twice to your application; compare resulting reports and review tasks.
Attempt a review decision with the analyst identity; the server or workflow must check authority.
Reject a submitted version with a reason, then attempt completion or export.
Use a short simulated review deadline; do not silently approve on timeout.
Approve one version, then change evidence or findings and attempt to reuse the old approval.
